media.title: Fire Pit & Patio Detail | Pensacola Residence
media.caption: The bright sunlight beaming down on this backyard was key to showing off that blue glass fire pit. It’s a great example of how a well-designed outdoor space becomes the centerpiece of a Pensacola home. This shot by ZB Captures highlights the flow from the custom stone patio to the screened-in porch.
media.alt: A wide-angle photo of a stone paver patio in Ensley, FL, featuring a large fire pit with blue glass and four wood chairs. A brick house with a screened-in porch is in the background under a blue sky.

media.name: 8-006_7604 Dewey Jernigan Rd.jpg
media.title: Modern Home Exterior | Pace, FL Real Estate
media.caption: Curb appeal is the first thing a buyer notices, and this modern craftsman in Pace, FL, is a perfect example. Between the clean board and batten siding and those sharp dormer windows, there’s a lot of character to capture here. At ZB Captures, I focus on wide, clean exterior angles that show off the full scale of the property and its landscaping, giving potential buyers a clear look at their future home.
media.alt: An exterior photograph of a light gray modern farmhouse with white trim and a two-car garage in Pace, FL. The house features a front porch with a white bench, two dormer windows, and a neatly landscaped front yard under a bright blue sky. Professional real estate photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: Interior (2).jpg
media.title: Updated Kitchen & Dining Area | Navarre, FL Real Estate
media.caption: Kitchens are the biggest selling point in any home, and this Navarre property shows why. Between the stainless steel appliances and the white subway tile, it’s got a clean, modern look that buyers love. I particularly like how the brick accent wall adds some texture to the dining nook. ZB Captures focuses on these interior details to help a listing feel like a home from the very first click.
media.alt: An interior photo of a kitchen and dining nook in a Navarre, FL home. The kitchen features white cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances, while the dining area has a grey brick accent wall and a hanging pendant light. Professional interior photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: c10226c9afc0bd9dcf11399c01e065bd
media.title: Oceanfront Bedroom View | Panama City Beach Real Estate
media.caption: There is nothing like a floor-to-ceiling view of the Gulf to sell a Panama City Beach condo. The challenge with shots like this is balancing the bright Florida sun outside with the interior details, but that’s where the right professional gear makes the difference. ZB Captures focuses on high-dynamic-range photography to ensure the white sands are just as clear as the coastal decor inside.
media.alt: A bright, airy bedroom in Panama City Beach, Florida, with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. The room features coastal decor, a white dresser, and a sliding glass door leading to a balcony. Professional interior photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: Untitled3.jpg
media.title: Open-Concept Coastal Living | Gulf Breeze, FL
media.caption: Capturing the flow of an open layout like this one in Gulf Breeze is all about finding the angle that shows how the rooms actually connect. The coastal accents and blue tones really pop against the warm flooring, giving the whole space a move-in-ready feel. At ZB Captures, I focus on wide-angle interiors that help potential buyers visualize themselves moving through the home.
media.alt: A wide-angle interior photograph of an open-concept living and dining area in a Gulf Breeze, FL home. The space features a coastal decor theme with blue accents, dark wood-style flooring, a large flat-screen TV, and a clear view into the kitchen and dining nook. Professional real estate photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: RE-1-2.jpg
media.title: Aerial Property View & Large Lot Layout | Milton, FL
media.caption: Ground photos only tell half the story, especially for homes in Milton with significant acreage. This top-down perspective highlights the entire layout—from the clean rooflines and paved driveway to the landscaped stone path leading through the yard. As an FAA Part 107 certified pilot, I ensure these aerials for ZB Captures aren't just high-up shots, but strategic views that show off the property's boundaries and potential.
media.alt: A high-resolution top-down aerial photograph of a residential property in Milton, FL. The image shows a dark-grey shingled roof, a wide concrete driveway, and a large, manicured green lawn with mature trees and a stone walking path. The bird's-eye view captures the full lot size and surrounding neighborhood context. Real estate drone photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: 15-14-print-396-revana-wy
media.title: Luxury Kitchen Interior & Granite Island | Crestview, FL
media.caption: Capturing a bright white kitchen without losing the details in the cabinets or the texture of the backsplash is always a rewarding challenge. This Crestview home is a showstopper, featuring a massive granite island and high-end stainless steel appliances that any home chef would love. At ZB Captures, I focus on highlighting these premium finishes—like the crown molding and custom pendant lighting—to ensure the listing stands out in the competitive North Florida market.
media.alt: An interior photograph of a modern, luxury kitchen in Crestview, FL. The image features a large white granite-topped island with a farmhouse sink, stainless steel appliances, and white shaker-style cabinets with glass-front uppers. Three large glass pendant lights hang above the island over hardwood floors. Professional real estate photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: 35-F8_5817 Front Beach Rd unit 1907_0034.jpg
media.title: Beachfront Balcony View with Pier | Panama City Beach, FL
media.caption: In a market like Panama City Beach, the balcony view is everything. This shot from a unit on Front Beach Road captures the iconic Russell-Fields Pier and the clear Gulf water that brings people to the Panhandle. Balancing the bright Florida sun with the vibrant turquoise of the water requires the right technical approach to ensure nothing gets blown out. At ZB Captures, I prioritize these "money shots" because they are often the first thing a potential guest or buyer clicks on.
media.alt: A high-angle view from a 19th-floor condo balcony in Panama City Beach, FL, looking down at the white sand beach and the Russell-Fields Pier. The turquoise water of the Gulf of Mexico is vibrant under a blue sky. The balcony features bright yellow walls and turquoise Adirondack chairs. Professional real estate photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: Untitled3-2.jpg
media.title: Bright Guest Bedroom & Skylight | Fort Walton Beach, FL
media.caption: A high-quality guest room is a major selling point in Fort Walton Beach, and this space proves why. By using a wide-angle lens and balancing the natural light from the skylight and the sliding glass door, I was able to capture an airy, inviting vibe that doesn't feel like an afterthought. ZB Captures focuses on making every room in the house look like the best seat in the house.
media.alt: A bright interior photo of a guest bedroom in Fort Walton Beach, FL, featuring a large skylight and sliding glass doors. The room is decorated with a coastal theme, including a nautical painting and neutral tones, over dark wood-look flooring. Professional real estate photography by ZB Captures.

media.name: Untitled.jpg
media.title: Spacious Open-Concept Living Area | Milton, FL
media.caption: A bright and inviting open-concept great room in Milton, FL, featuring vaulted ceilings and a seamless flow from the foyer to the main living space. The interior is anchored by warm hardwood flooring and light neutral walls, offering a versatile layout with distinct seating areas, thoughtful built-in storage solutions, and immediate access to a comfortable guest suite.
media.alt: A wide-angle interior shot of a sunlit living room with vaulted ceilings and a brown ceiling fan. A grey sectional and a blue storage bench sit on a large patterned rug. To the left, a doorway reveals a bedroom with a dark grey bed. To the right, a tiled entryway leads to a white front door with a decorative window.
